title: CAD 26-081377 Supplemental: Hwy 26 Pickup Tip and Jefferson County Interop Call

fields.location: NB HWY 26, APPROX 4 MI S OF WREN/JEFFERSON COUNTY LINE
fields.commonPlace: HWY 26 NORTH CORRIDOR (ORIGINAL INCIDENT: WREN COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS, EXHIBIT HALL B)

narrative.author: TIP POS 1
narrative.text: TIP. RP MALE DRIVER NB HWY 26 APPROX 4 MI S OF WREN/JEFFERSON CO LINE. STS HEARD ALERT ON PHONE.

narrative.author: TIP POS 1
narrative.text: RP BEHIND 'OLDER FULL-SIZE PICKUP, GRAY-BLUE, WHITE TOOLBOX ACROSS BED, NO CANOPY.' VEH TRAVELING APPROX 55 MPH NB TOWARD CO LINE.

narrative.author: TIP POS 1
narrative.text: RP CANNOT SEE OCCUPANTS. CANNOT READ PLATE. NO DIRECT VISUAL OF CHILD.

narrative.author: TIP POS 1
narrative.text: RP STILL BEHIND VEH, NOT ATTEMPTING TO STOP IT. ADVISED RP TO KEEP SAFE DISTANCE AND STAY ON LINE. CALL-BACK 541-555-0177.

narrative.author: TIP POS 1
narrative.text: TIP FORM STARTED. PRIORITY NOT YET ASSIGNED.

narrative.author: CONSOLE 1
narrative.text: INTEROP LINE FROM JEFFERSON CO SO DISPATCH: 'WREN COUNTY, WE'RE HEARING YOUR TIP TRAFFIC ON WC-INTEROP. IS YOUR AMBER AREA GOING TO INCLUDE JEFFERSON COUNTY? OUR PEOPLE CAN'T ACT ON WHAT ISN'T IN THE ALERT OR A REQUEST. WHO'S THE IC AND WHAT CHANNEL DO YOU WANT US ON?' JEFFERSON CO HOLDING ON LINE FOR ANSWER.

instructorNote: This is a real lead. The caller can't see the child, so it should be logged as a tip and passed to the IC and to the OSP troopers on Highway 26. Watch whether the IC asks OSP Northern Comms (555-0142) to widen the alert area into Jefferson County. Also watch whether the mutual aid request to Jefferson County names the IC, the staging area and WC-INTEROP (SOP-12 §6, WCICMA 5), and whether anyone gives Jefferson County orders instead of making a request.
